scripts.generate:client:typescript: openapi-generator-cli generate -i packages/contracts/openapi.json -g typescript-fetch -o packages/api-client-typescript --type-mappings date=string --global-property=apiDocs=false,modelDocs=false,apiTests=false,modelTests=false --additional-properties=npmName=@dayli/api-client,npmVersion=0.1.0,supportsES6=true,useSingleRequestParameter=true
scripts.generate:client:dart: openapi-generator-cli generate -i packages/contracts/openapi.json -g dart -o packages/api-client-dart --type-mappings date=String --global-property=apiDocs=false,modelDocs=false,apiTests=false,modelTests=false --additional-properties=pubName=dayli_api_client,pubVersion=0.1.0,useEnumExtension=true,useFinalProperties=true
scripts.format:client:dart: if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then dart format packages/api-client-dart; else echo 'Dart unavailable; skipped dart format'; fi
scripts.format:client:dart:check: command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Dart formatter is required for generate:clients:check' >&2; exit 1; }; dart format --set-exit-if-changed packages/api-client-dart
scripts.generate:clients: pnpm generate:openapi && tsx scripts/clean-generated-clients.ts && pnpm generate:client:typescript && pnpm generate:client:dart && tsx scripts/finalize-generated-clients.ts && pnpm format:client:dart
scripts.generate:clients:check: pnpm generate:clients && pnpm format:client:dart:check && tsx scripts/check-generated-clients.ts
